arxiv-2006-12838.title: Analytic Solution to the Piecewise Linear Interface Construction Problem and its Application in Curvature Calculation for Volume-of-Fluid Simulation Codes
arxiv-2006-12838.creator: Moritz Lehmann Stephan Gekle
arxiv-2006-12838.description: Abstract Keywords PLIC, plane-cube intersection, Volume-of-Fluid, Lattice Boltzmann Method, GPU, OpenCL Abstract The plane-cube intersection problem has been around in literature since 1984 and iterative solutions to it have been used as part of piecewise linear interface construction (PLIC) in computational fluid dynamics simulation codes ever since.

arxiv-2111-04201.title: Corrections to Extremal Black Holes from Iyer-Wald Formalism
arxiv-2111-04201.creator: Lars Aalsma
arxiv-2111-04201.description: Abstract We present a general method of computing corrections to the extremality bound and entropy of Kerr-Newman black holes due to an arbitrary perturbation using the Iyer-Wald formalism. In this method, corrections to the extremality bound are given by an integral over an effective stress tensor which, in particular cases of interest, reduces to the usual stress tensor.

arxiv-2204-13837.title: Linear stability of black holes with static scalar hair in full Horndeski theories: generic instabilities and surviving models Preprint: YITP-22-41, WUAP-22-03
arxiv-2204-13837.creator: Masato Minamitsuji, 1 Kazufumi Takahashi, 2 and Shinji Tsujikawa 3
arxiv-2204-13837.description: Abstract In full Horndeski theories, we show that the static and spherically symmetric black hole (BH) solutions with a static scalar field ϕ \phi whose kinetic term X X is nonvanishing on the BH horizon are generically prone to ghost/Laplacian instabilities.

arxiv-2206-13350.creator: Cansu Betin Onur
arxiv-2206-13350.description: Abstract While the amount of data produced and accumulated continues to advance at unprecedented rates, protection and concealment of data increase its prominence as a field of scientific study that requires more action. It is essential to protect privacy-sensitive data at every phase; at rest, at run, and while computations are executed on data.

arxiv-2302-01495.title: Characterization of Quantum Frequency Processors
arxiv-2302-01495.creator: Hsuan-Hao Lu, Nicholas A. Peters, Andrew M. Weiner, Joseph M. Lukens
arxiv-2302-01495.description: Abstract Frequency-bin qubits possess unique synergies with wavelength-multiplexed lightwave communications, suggesting valuable opportunities for quantum networking with the existing fiber-optic infrastructure. Although the coherent manipulation of frequency-bin states requires highly controllable multi-spectral-mode interference, the quantum frequency processor (QFP) provides a scalable path for gate synthesis leveraging standard telecom components.

arxiv-2311-10934.title: Case Repositories: Towards Case-Based Reasoning for AI Alignment
arxiv-2311-10934.creator: K. J. Kevin Feng, Quan Ze Chen, Inyoung Cheong, King Xia, Amy X. Zhang
arxiv-2311-10934.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by K. J. Kevin Feng, Quan Ze Chen, Inyoung Cheong, King Xia, Amy X. Zhang. Case studies commonly form the pedagogical backbone in law, ethics, and many other domains that face complex and ambiguous societal questions informed by human values. Similar complexities and ambiguities arise when we consider how AI should be aligned in practice: when faced with vast quantities of diverse (and sometimes conflicting) values from different individuals and communities, with whose values is AI to align, and how should AI do so?

arxiv-2401-06630.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . The ATLAS trigger system is a crucial component of the ATLAS experiment at the LHC. It is responsible for selecting events in line with the ATLAS physics programme. This paper presents an overview of the changes to the trigger and data acquisition system during the second long shutdown of the LHC, and shows the performance of the trigger system and its components in the proton–proton collisions during the 2022 commissioning period as well as its expected performance in proton–proton and heavy–ion collisions for

arxiv-2402-07177.creator: Di Wang
arxiv-2402-07177.description: Abstract Context. A plausible origin for the quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs) could be mass loss at the periastron of a body moving around the supermassive black hole (SMBH) on a highly eccentric orbit. This kind of tidally stripped star is expected to radiate gravitational waves, thereby leading to a shrinkage of the periastron distance.

arxiv-2407-07293.description: Abstract A group of privately informed agents chooses between two alternatives. How should the decision rule be designed if agents are known to be biased in favor of one of the options? We address this question by considering the Condorcet Jury Setting as a mechanism design problem.

arxiv-2502-18891.title: Dynamic Classification: Leveraging Self- supervised Classification to Enhance Prediction Performance
arxiv-2502-18891.creator: First A. ZIYUAN ZHONG, zzy13534959496@163.com
arxiv-2502-18891.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by First A. ZIYUAN ZHONG, zzy13534959496@163.com. In this study, we propose an innovative dynamic classification algorithm aimed at achieving zero missed detections and minimal false positives, critical in safety-critical domains (e.g., medical diagnostics) where undetected cases risk severe outcomes. The algorithm partitions data in a self-supervised learning-generated way, which allows the model to learn from the training set to understand the data distribution and thereby divides training set and test set into N different subareas.

arxiv-2504-16781.title: Strain Effect on Rashba Splitting and Phonon Scattering to Improve Thermoelectric Performance of 2D Heterobilayer MoTe 2 /PtS 2
arxiv-2504-16781.creator: Vuong Van Thanh, Nguyen Tuan Hung
arxiv-2504-16781.description: Abstract Rashba spin-orbit coupling significantly modifies the electronic band structure in two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) heterobilayers, which may enhance their thermoelectric (TE) properties. In this study, we use first-principles calculations and Boltzmann transport theory to explore the strain effect on the TE performance of the 2D vdW heterobilayer MoTe 2 /PtS 2 .

arxiv-2512-04251.title: Ferroelectric Hysteresis in Superconducting Bilayers
arxiv-2512-04251.creator: Yanfang Li, Xin-Zhi Li, Wen-Yu He
arxiv-2512-04251.description: Abstract Recently, coexisting ferroelectricity and superconductivity were reported in bilayer T d {}_{\textrm{d}} -MoTe 2 and twisted bilayer graphene. Importantly, it was observed that an applied displacement field switches the superconductivity with a ferroelectric hysteresis. Such direct coupling between the ferroelectricity and superconductivity offers promising pathways for developing low-power, non-volatile memory devices.

arxiv-2602-09663.title: Global statistical entropy and its implications for the main sequences of stars and galaxies
arxiv-2602-09663.creator: D. Elbaz
arxiv-2602-09663.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by D. Elbaz. In a dissipative system such as star or a galaxy, the emitted photons are decoupled from matter particles and may therefore be considered as part of a closed system to which the second law of thermodynamics applies. In the present work, I defined a global entropy using a statistical approach that accounts for the contributions of both matter particles and photons. The statistical contribution of radiation is described as a photon gas in the definition of this global entropy.

pmc-11343867.title: Central pathology review and its prognostic value in upper tract urothelial carcinoma patients: a nationwide multi-institutional study
pmc-11343867.creator: Yung-Tai Chen, Hsiang Ying Lee, Wen-Jeng Wu, Ching-Chia Li, Chih-Hung Lin, Chung-Tai Yue, Yuan-Hong Jiang, Yu-Khun Lee, Kuan Hsun Huang, Yao-Chou Tsai
pmc-11343867.description: The prognostic value of central pathology review in upper urinary tract cancer (UTUC) remains inadequately addressed in existing literature. In this study, we conducted an extensive central pathology review and presented its influence on multi-center UTUC studies. We conducted a retrospective review of patients who underwent radical nephroureterectomy or segmental resection for UTUC to determine eligibility for central pathology review.

pmc-11477696.title: Mixed-Curve Model for Evaluating the Carbonation Depth of Concrete at Different Ages
pmc-11477696.creator: Xinhao Wang, Qiuwei Yang, Hongfei Cao, Fengjiang Qin
pmc-11477696.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). To accurately quantify the variation in concrete carbonation depth, selecting an appropriate mathematical curve model is crucial. Currently prevalent models, such as the Fick model and exponential models, confront limitations in prediction accuracy and range of application. Given that a single curve model struggles to precisely describe the pattern of concrete carbonation, this work introduces a mixed-curve-based prediction model for carbonation depth, effectively integrating the Fick model with a hyperbolic model.

pmc-11655733.title: Current status of treatment for malignant ovarian sex cord-stromal tumors
pmc-11655733.creator: Fang Chunli, Chen Hailin, Zhou Yingying, Xiao Huajing, Xu Boqun
pmc-11655733.description: Malignant ovarian sex cord-stromal tumors belong to a specific type of ovarian epithelial carcinoma, and their prognosis is related to the kind of pathology. Unlike epithelial ovarian cancer, most malignant ovarian sex cord-stromal tumors are low-grade malignant and have a good prognosis.

pmc-12498357.title: Unmet needs and new challenges in young women’s sexual and reproductive health and rights: a qualitative study in Chile’s Metropolitan Region
pmc-12498357.creator: Alexandra Obach, Michelle Sadler, Consuelo Robledo, Ciara Wright, Báltica Cabieses
pmc-12498357.description: In Chile, despite important advances in access to contraception and a steady reduction in unplanned pregnancy, longstanding barriers for young people to access sexual and reproductive health (SRH) and rights – rooted in a conservative and religious background – have been highlighted by recent socio-political movements, including the feminist student wave of 2018 and the social uprising of 2019.

pmc-12590268.title: Arabinogalactan-proteins of the eusporangiate fern Psilotum nudum show atypical structural features compared to other ferns
pmc-12590268.creator: Kim-Kristine Mueller, Lukas Pfeifer, Urska Repnik, Marc Bramkamp, Birgit Classen
pmc-12590268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). During the colonization of land, abiotic and biotic challenges induced strong adaptations in plants, including changes of their cell walls. Up to now, cell walls of spore-bearing plants have been only sparsely investigated. As ferns are the sister group to seed plants, studying their cell walls is key to understanding the evolutionary development of the cell wall in the tracheophyte lineage. Beside polysaccharides, especially arabinogalactan-proteins (AGPs) are important cell wall components involved in structural but also signalling functions.

pmc-12690720.title: CERG-05 THE ZIMBABWEAN PEDIATRIC NEURO-ONCOLOGY MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM PROGRAM, INCEPTION AND CHALLENGES ENCOUNTERED
pmc-12690720.creator: Daniel Dzinotyiwei, Shungu Ushewokunze, Luxwell Jokonya, Loyce T Hlatywayo, Maximilian Dzowa, Nathaniel Zimani, Killion Madondoro, Sharon Soko, Edith Matsikidze, Shamiso Chowe, Blessing Zambuko, Nancy Jonker, Kazadi Kalangu
pmc-12690720.description: BackgroundIn our quest to improve pediatric neuro-oncological care in government tertiary institutions, growing calls to set up a recurring monthly MDT meeting finally came to fruition in 2024 despite the challenges characteristic of setting up a new program in a developing nation.

pmc-13085053.title: Toxicological profile of anti-diabetic drugs and emerging measures to reduce the toxic burden
pmc-13085053.creator: George J. Dugbartey, Karl K. Alornyo, Christabel O. Dapaa-Addo, Emmanuel K. Kwashie, Yvonne Harley, Bright N. Asiedu
pmc-13085053.description: Diabetes mellitus (DM) is a major public health concern of the 21st century, with global figures of the diabetic population expected to reach approximately 700 million by 2045. In the face of this rapidly increasing trend in global prevalence of DM, various therapeutic strategies have been explored and developed to mitigate this alarming increase.

pmc-13218934.title: Distributed quantum sensing with measurement-after-interaction strategies
pmc-13218934.creator: Jiajie Guo, Shuheng Liu, Matteo Fadel, Qiongyi He
pmc-13218934.description: We investigate multiparameter quantum estimation protocols based on measurement-after-interaction (MAI) strategies, in which the probe state undergoes an additional evolution prior to linear measurements. As we show in our study, this extra evolution enables different level of advantages depending on whether it is implemented locally or nonlocally across the sensing nodes.

pmc-13285486.title: Sex differences in atrial fibrillation recurrence after catheter ablation: research status and progress
pmc-13285486.creator: Yongzhi Cao, Hao Wang, Chengyu Shi, Yunfei Gu
pmc-13285486.description: Sex differences in the risk of recurrence after catheter (CA) ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF) have become a focal point of interest in recent years. This narrative review synthesizes the available evidence and, based on published reports, suggests that female patients may have a higher overall risk of postoperative recurrence than male patients, although substantial heterogeneity exists across studies.

pmc-13383586.title: Spontaneous perineural hematoma of a lumbar nerve root presenting as radiculopathy successfully treated with needle aspiration: illustrative case
pmc-13383586.creator: Junichi Yokosuka, Yuichi Takano, Hirohiko Inanami, Hiroki Iwai
pmc-13383586.description: BACKGROUNDSpinal hemorrhagic disorders are relatively uncommon. Hematomas occurring outside the spinal canal, particularly around the spinal nerve root, are especially rare. To date, reported cases have been limited to a single case associated with a nerve root block procedure and 9 cases of Tarlov cyst hemorrhage.OBSERVATIONSA 35-year-old woman presented with acute right L5 radiculopathy and extensor hallucis longus weakness.

pmc-13477575.title: Pseudo-Pulseless Electrical Activity With Anaphylaxis in a Pediatric Surgical Patient: A Case Report
pmc-13477575.creator: Joshua Stopak, Martha O Herbst, Alexandria R Nicolaus, Timothy W Morris
pmc-13477575.description: Pseudo-pulseless electrical activity (p-PEA) is a clinical condition where cardiac output drops severely enough to produce a non-palpable pulse in the setting of organized electrical activity of the heart, but imaging or monitors display evidence of cardiac motion. It may be seen in shock states such as anaphylactic shock.

pmc-13586622.title: Exploring the roles of informal healthcare providers in urban settings to improve access and quality of care for the urban poor: experience from Bangladesh, Ghana, Nepal, and Nigeria
pmc-13586622.creator: Dominic Dormenyo Gadeka, Bryony Dawkins, Noemia Teixeira de Siqueira Filha, Asiful Haidar Chowdhury, Abhigyna Bhattarai, Chinyere Mbachu, Md Badruddin Saify, Henry Okudzeto, Mattheus Rodrigues Da Silva, Sushil Chandra Baral, Zahidul Quayyum, Genevieve Cecilia Aryeetey, Rumana Huque, Obinna Onwujekwe
pmc-13586622.description: Though informal healthcare providers (IHPs), often defined as unregistered and not formally trained, are heavily utilized by low-income urban residents and present an opportunity to address the urban primary care gap, these providers are rarely prioritized or integrated into health systems.

uslaw-usc-t32-s301.title: 32 U.S.C. § 301 — Federal recognition of enlisted members

uslaw-usc-t32-s301.description: United States Code, Title 32 (National Guard); Chapter 3 (Personnel). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. To be eligible for Federal recognition as an enlisted member of the National Guard, a person must have the qualifications prescribed by the Secretary concerned for the grade, branch, position, and type of unit or organization involved. He becomes federally recognized upon enlisting in a federally recognized.
